changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: create table interaction_clarification ( id bigint not null auto_increment primary key, interaction_id bigint not null, content json not null, answered_at datetime null, chosen_hypothesis varchar(255) null, constraint ux_interaction_clarification_interaction unique (interaction_id), constraint fk_interaction_clarification_interaction foreign key (interaction_id) references interaction (id) );
